body: everything which depends on something which has its version changed changes too, so as InstantSearch is updated, this updates too. That's lerna behaviour which can't be changed as far as I can tell

as far as I can tell you can't ask it to update the dependency update, but not update a version? but possibly the version number can be removed from those packages, as they aren't depended upon or published

more info here: https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/1586 and https://github.com/lerna/lerna/issues/1942#issuecomment-468001574
no, I think what happened is that because these are local packages that aren't published, lerna doesn't know about the 4.0.0 tag (we should add it in shipjs) and thus always does a from-scratch diff.
